optimized_sql:
WITH state_values AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT s_state
    FROM store
    WHERE s_state IN ('TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN')
)
SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    s.s_state,
    grouping(s.s_state) AS g_state,
    avg(ss.ss_quantity) AS agg1,
    avg(ss.ss_list_price) AS agg2,
    avg(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3,
    avg(ss.ss_sales_price) AS agg4
FROM item AS i
JOIN date_dim AS d
    ON d.d_year = 1999
JOIN store AS s
    ON s.s_state IN ('TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN')
JOIN state_values AS sv
    ON sv.s_state = s.s_state
JOIN customer_demographics AS cd
    ON cd.cd_gender = 'M'
   AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'W'
   AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Secondary'
JOIN store_sales AS ss
    ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
   AND ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
   AND ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
   AND ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i.i_item_id, s.s_state)
ORDER BY i.i_item_id, s.s_state
LIMIT 100
